bd-l02-ex-2-1.name: forgets the birth date column

bd-l02-ex-2-3.name: gives two columns the same alias

bd-l03-ex-2-inline-2.name: no parentheses: only 100 is halved

bd-l03-ex-x1.name: leaves out the spaces between the pieces

bd-l04-ex-x1.name: writes the group in lower case
bd-l04-ex-x1.sql: SELECT nume, prenume FROM studenti WHERE an = 2 AND grupa <> 'a1'

bd-l04-ex-x2.name: no parentheses around the OR
bd-l04-ex-x2.sql: SELECT nume, prenume FROM studenti WHERE bursa IS NOT NULL AND an = 2 OR an = 3

bd-l05-ex-2-7.name: tests the missing value with = NULL

bd-l05-ex-2-9.name: forgets the IS NOT NULL filter

bd-l06-ex-2-10.name: writes the P in lower case

bd-l06-ex-2-13.name: tests the scholarship with <> NULL

bd-l06-ex-2-14.name: at least one a instead of exactly one

bd-l06-ex-2-11.name: only the "at least two" condition, no NOT LIKE for three
bd-l06-ex-2-11.sql: SELECT * FROM studenti WHERE prenume LIKE '%a%a%'

bd-l06-ex-2-11.name: only the NOT LIKE condition, no "at least two"
bd-l06-ex-2-11.sql: SELECT * FROM studenti WHERE prenume NOT LIKE '%a%a%a%'

bd-l07-ex-2-12.name: AND instead of OR between the names
bd-l07-ex-2-12.sql: SELECT * FROM studenti WHERE prenume = 'Alexandru' AND prenume = 'Ioana' AND prenume = 'Marius'

bd-l07-ex-x1.name: the limits of BETWEEN in the wrong order
bd-l07-ex-x1.sql: SELECT nume, bursa FROM studenti WHERE bursa BETWEEN 400 AND 300

bd-l07-ex-x2.name: a NULL in the NOT IN list
bd-l07-ex-x2.sql: SELECT nume, prenume FROM studenti WHERE grupa NOT IN ('A1', 'A2', 'B1', NULL)

bd-l08-ex-2-4.name: orders by name only, not by year first
bd-l08-ex-2-4.sql: SELECT nume || ' ' || prenume || ', ' || an AS "Studenți pe ani de studiu" FROM studenti ORDER BY nume, prenume

bd-l08-ex-2-8.name: an = 2 AND an = 3 (a student in both years)
bd-l08-ex-2-8.sql: SELECT nume, prenume FROM studenti WHERE bursa IS NOT NULL AND an = 2 AND an = 3 ORDER BY nume ASC, prenume DESC

bd-l08-ex-2-8.name: prenume ascending instead of descending
bd-l08-ex-2-8.sql: SELECT nume, prenume FROM studenti WHERE bursa IS NOT NULL AND an IN (2, 3) ORDER BY nume ASC, prenume ASC

bd-l09-ex-x1.name: sorts descending instead of ascending
bd-l09-ex-x1.sql: SELECT nume FROM studenti WHERE an = 1 UNION SELECT nume FROM studenti WHERE an = 3 ORDER BY nume DESC

bd-l09-ex-x2.name: UNION instead of INTERSECT
bd-l09-ex-x2.sql: SELECT prenume FROM studenti WHERE an = 2 UNION SELECT prenume FROM studenti WHERE an = 3

bd-l09-ex-x3.name: subtracts the lists the wrong way round
bd-l09-ex-x3.sql: SELECT nume FROM studenti WHERE an = 3 MINUS SELECT nume FROM studenti WHERE an = 1

bd-l10-ex-x1.name: rounds decimals (1) instead of tens (-1)
bd-l10-ex-x1.sql: SELECT CEIL(51.3), FLOOR(-51.3), ROUND(21.665, 1), MOD(26, 11) FROM DUAL

bd-l10-ex-x2.name: rounds to tens (-1) instead of hundreds
bd-l10-ex-x2.sql: SELECT nume, ROUND(bursa, -1) FROM studenti WHERE bursa IS NOT NULL

bd-l11-ex-3-6.name: LENGTH of the padded CHAR column, no TRIM
bd-l11-ex-3-6.sql: SELECT LOWER(SUBSTR(TRIM(nume), 1, 1)) || UPPER(SUBSTR(TRIM(nume), 2)), LENGTH(nume) FROM profesori WHERE nume LIKE 'B%'

bd-l11-ex-2-15.name: LIKE on the padded first name, no TRIM
bd-l11-ex-2-15.sql: SELECT nume, prenume FROM profesori WHERE prenume LIKE '%n'

bd-l12-ex-3-4.name: forgets the space after Elevul
bd-l12-ex-3-4.sql: SELECT CONCAT(CONCAT(CONCAT('Elevul', prenume), ' este in grupa '), grupa) FROM studenti

bd-l12-ex-3-13.name: forgets the filter on students with a grant
bd-l12-ex-3-13.sql: SELECT nume, LPAD(RPAD('*', bursa / 50, '*'), 9) FROM studenti

bd-l13-ex-3-2.name: arguments of MONTHS_BETWEEN swapped
bd-l13-ex-3-2.sql: SELECT nume, data_nastere, MONTHS_BETWEEN(data_nastere, SYSDATE) FROM studenti

bd-l13-ex-x1.name: first day of the month instead of the last
bd-l13-ex-x1.sql: SELECT nume, data_nastere, TRUNC(data_nastere, 'MM') FROM studenti

bd-l14-ex-3-3.name: the number of the weekday instead of its name
bd-l14-ex-3-3.sql: SELECT nume, prenume, TO_CHAR(data_nastere, 'D') AS zi FROM studenti

bd-l14-ex-2-6.name: the two-digit year mask YY against 1995
bd-l14-ex-2-6.sql: SELECT nume, prenume, an FROM studenti WHERE TO_CHAR(data_nastere, 'YY') = '1995'

bd-l14-ex-2-5.name: the ends of BETWEEN swapped
bd-l14-ex-2-5.sql: SELECT nume, prenume, data_nastere FROM studenti WHERE data_nastere BETWEEN TO_DATE('10-06-1997', 'DD-MM-YYYY') AND TO_DATE('01-01-1995', 'DD-MM-YYYY') ORDER BY an DESC

bd-l14-ex-3-8.name: sorts by the month name, so APRIL comes before FEBRUARY
bd-l14-ex-3-8.sql: SELECT nume, prenume, TO_CHAR(data_nastere, 'MONTH') AS luna FROM studenti WHERE bursa IS NULL ORDER BY TO_CHAR(data_nastere, 'MONTH')

bd-l14-ex-x1.name: no language parameter, day names stay English
bd-l14-ex-x1.sql: SELECT nume, TO_CHAR(data_nastere, 'fmDay') AS zi FROM studenti

bd-l15-ex-3-7.name: forgets the +1: picks the birthday that already passed
bd-l15-ex-3-7.sql: SELECT nume, data_nastere, ADD_MONTHS(data_nastere, 12 * (TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(SYSDATE), data_nastere) / 12))) AS aniversare, NEXT_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(data_nastere, 12 * (TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(SYSDATE), data_nastere) / 12))), 'SUNDAY') AS duminica FROM studenti

bd-l15-ex-3-11.name: SYSDATE instead of TRUNC(SYSDATE): days with a fraction
bd-l15-ex-3-11.sql: SELECT nume, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(SYSDATE), data_nastere) / 12) || ' ani ' || TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(SYSDATE), data_nastere), 12)) || ' luni și ' || (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - ADD_MONTHS(data_nastere, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(SYSDATE), data_nastere)))) || ' zile' AS varsta, ADD_MONTHS(data_nastere, 12 * (TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(SYSDATE), data_nastere) / 12) + 1)) - SYSDATE AS zile_pana FROM studenti

bd-l16-ex-3-9.name: no NULL pair in DECODE
bd-l16-ex-3-9.sql: SELECT nume, bursa, DECODE(bursa, 450, 'premiul 1', 350, 'premiul 2', 250, 'premiul 3') AS "Premiu" FROM studenti

bd-l16-ex-3-12.name: no NULL pair, so no 0
bd-l16-ex-3-12.sql: SELECT nume, TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 1), 'MM') AS prima_zi, DECODE(bursa, 450, bursa * 1.10, 350, bursa * 1.15, 250, bursa * 1.20) AS bursa_noua FROM studenti

bd-l16-ex-x1.name: the two WHENs swapped
bd-l16-ex-x1.sql: SELECT nume, CASE WHEN bursa IS NOT NULL THEN 'mica' WHEN bursa > 300 THEN 'mare' ELSE 'fara' END AS categorie FROM studenti

bd-l16-ex-x2.name: puts 0 instead of the text
bd-l16-ex-x2.sql: SELECT nume, NVL(TO_CHAR(bursa), 0) AS bursa FROM studenti

bd-l18-ex-x1.name: no link condition: Cartesian product
bd-l18-ex-x1.sql: SELECT s.nume, s.prenume, n.valoare FROM studenti s CROSS JOIN note n

bd-l18-ex-x2.name: forgets the link between the two tables
bd-l18-ex-x2.sql: SELECT s.nume, s.prenume, n.valoare FROM studenti s, note n WHERE s.prenume = 'Ioana'

bd-l19-ex-4-3.name: the second ON compares didactic with itself
bd-l19-ex-4-3.sql: SELECT p.nume, p.prenume, c.titlu_curs FROM profesori p JOIN didactic d ON p.id_prof = d.id_prof JOIN cursuri c ON d.id_curs = d.id_curs

bd-l19-ex-4-2.name: brings in didactic, which doubles the rows
bd-l19-ex-4-2.sql: SELECT s.nume, s.prenume FROM studenti s JOIN note n ON s.nr_matricol = n.nr_matricol JOIN cursuri c ON c.id_curs = n.id_curs JOIN didactic d ON d.id_curs = c.id_curs WHERE n.valoare = 10 AND c.titlu_curs = 'BD'

bd-l19-ex-4-1.name: the professors joined against themselves
bd-l19-ex-4-1.sql: SELECT s.nume, s.prenume, c.titlu_curs, n.valoare, p.nume, p.prenume FROM studenti s JOIN note n ON s.nr_matricol = n.nr_matricol JOIN cursuri c ON c.id_curs = n.id_curs JOIN didactic d ON d.id_curs = c.id_curs JOIN profesori p ON p.id_prof = p.id_prof

bd-l20-ex-x1.name: tests the key with = NULL
bd-l20-ex-x1.sql: SELECT s.nume, s.prenume FROM studenti s LEFT JOIN note n ON s.nr_matricol = n.nr_matricol WHERE n.nr_matricol = NULL

bd-l20-ex-4-4.name: the second join stays a plain JOIN
bd-l20-ex-4-4.sql: SELECT p.nume, p.prenume, c.titlu_curs FROM profesori p LEFT JOIN didactic d ON p.id_prof = d.id_prof JOIN cursuri c ON d.id_curs = c.id_curs

bd-l20-ex-4-5.name: plain JOINs: the course without a professor disappears
bd-l20-ex-4-5.sql: SELECT p.nume, p.prenume, c.titlu_curs FROM cursuri c JOIN didactic d ON c.id_curs = d.id_curs JOIN profesori p ON d.id_prof = p.id_prof

bd-l20-ex-4-6.name: LEFT JOINs only: the course without a professor is missing
bd-l20-ex-4-6.sql: SELECT p.nume, p.prenume, c.titlu_curs FROM profesori p LEFT JOIN didactic d ON p.id_prof = d.id_prof LEFT JOIN cursuri c ON d.id_curs = c.id_curs

bd-l21-ex-x1.name: <> instead of <: every pair twice and the pair with oneself
bd-l21-ex-x1.sql: SELECT s1.nume, s2.nume FROM studenti s1 JOIN studenti s2 ON s1.grupa = s2.grupa AND s1.an = s2.an AND s1.nr_matricol <> s2.nr_matricol

bd-l21-ex-4-9.name: <> instead of <: each pair twice
bd-l21-ex-4-9.sql: SELECT s1.nume AS nume1, s1.prenume AS prenume1, s2.nume AS nume2, s2.prenume AS prenume2, ABS(s1.data_nastere - s2.data_nastere) AS diferenta_zile FROM studenti s1 JOIN studenti s2 ON s1.nr_matricol <> s2.nr_matricol ORDER BY diferenta_zile

bd-l21-ex-4-10.name: LENGTH of the padded CHAR column, no TRIM
bd-l21-ex-4-10.sql: SELECT s.nume, s.prenume, p.nume, p.prenume FROM studenti s JOIN profesori p ON LENGTH(s.nume) = LENGTH(p.nume)

bd-l21-ex-4-7.name: s1.nume < s2.nume alone loses the Bodnar-Bodnar pair
bd-l21-ex-4-7.sql: SELECT s1.nume AS nume1, s2.nume AS nume2, TO_CHAR(s1.data_nastere, 'fmDay') AS zi FROM studenti s1 JOIN studenti s2 ON TO_CHAR(s1.data_nastere, 'D') = TO_CHAR(s2.data_nastere, 'D') AND s1.nume < s2.nume ORDER BY TRUNC(s1.data_nastere) - TRUNC(s1.data_nastere, 'IW'), s1.nume, s2.nume

bd-l22-ex-4-8.name: >= instead of >: ties become sentences
bd-l22-ex-4-8.sql:
SELECT s2.nume || ' ' || s2.prenume || ' a luat notă mai mare ca ' || s1.nume || ' ' || s1.prenume || ' la materia ' || c.titlu_curs || '.' AS propozitie
FROM studenti s1
  JOIN note n1 ON n1.nr_matricol = s1.nr_matricol
  JOIN note n2 ON n2.id_curs = n1.id_curs AND n2.valoare >= n1.valoare
  JOIN studenti s2 ON s2.nr_matricol = n2.nr_matricol
  JOIN cursuri c ON c.id_curs = n1.id_curs

bd-l23-ex-4-11.name: forgets DISTINCT
bd-l23-ex-4-11.sql:
SELECT c.titlu_curs
FROM cursuri c
  JOIN note n ON n.id_curs = c.id_curs
WHERE n.valoare <= 8

bd-l23-ex-4-12.name: nume and prenume only in both SELECTs: the two Bodnar Ioana merge
bd-l23-ex-4-12.sql:
SELECT s.nume, s.prenume
FROM studenti s
  JOIN note n ON n.nr_matricol = s.nr_matricol
MINUS
SELECT s.nume, s.prenume
FROM studenti s
  JOIN note n ON n.nr_matricol = s.nr_matricol
WHERE n.valoare < 7

bd-l24-ex-4-13.name: the padded DAY mask against TUESDAY
bd-l24-ex-4-13.sql:
SELECT s.nume, s.prenume, n.valoare
FROM studenti s
  JOIN note n ON n.nr_matricol = s.nr_matricol
  JOIN cursuri c ON c.id_curs = n.id_curs
WHERE c.titlu_curs = 'OOP'
  AND n.valoare IN (7, 10)
  AND TO_CHAR(n.data_notare, 'DAY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') = 'TUESDAY'

bd-l24-ex-4-14.name: no fm: the month name stays padded
bd-l24-ex-4-14.sql:
SELECT s.nume, s.prenume, n.valoare,
       TO_CHAR(n.data_notare, 'MONTH, YYYY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS sesiune,
       CASE WHEN LAST_DAY(n.data_notare) - TRUNC(n.data_notare, 'MM') + 1 < 30 THEN '+' END AS mai_grea
FROM studenti s
  JOIN note n ON n.nr_matricol = s.nr_matricol
  JOIN cursuri c ON c.id_curs = n.id_curs
WHERE c.titlu_curs = 'OOP'
  AND n.valoare >= 5

bd-l25-ex-x1.name: plain JOIN: the course without a professor disappears
bd-l25-ex-x1.sql:
SELECT c.titlu_curs, TRIM(p.nume) AS nume
FROM cursuri c
  JOIN didactic d ON d.id_curs = c.id_curs
  JOIN profesori p ON p.id_prof = d.id_prof
WHERE c.an = 2

bd-l25-ex-x2.name: forgets the MINUS: every course that has grades
bd-l25-ex-x2.sql: SELECT c.id_curs, c.titlu_curs FROM cursuri c JOIN note n ON n.id_curs = c.id_curs
